relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: Son of Professor Richard Hönigswald (1875–1947), a philosopher of Austro-Bohemian Jewish origin

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: matriculated 1932. Studied comparative linguistics at Munich (just one year)

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: Ph.D. 1936 Florence (unpublished. diss. on the history of Greek word formation, under G. Devoto)

relations.object: Institute of Etruscan Research in Florence

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: In 1939-42 Lecturer in Linguistics at Yale

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: 1942-43 Lecturer in Phonetics and Linguistics at Hartford Semin. Foundation

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: In 1943-44 taught Hindi for the army at University of Pennsylvania

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: In 1945-46 Research Assistant in Linguistics at Yale (under Sturtevant)

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.object: Foreign Service Instit., U.S. Department of State
relations.evidence: in 1946-47 staff member at Foreign Service Instit., U.S. Department of State

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: In 1948-59 Associate Professor of Linguistics at University of Pennsylvania

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: in 1959-85 full Professor and 1963-70 Chairman of Department of Linguistics there. Emeritus in 1985.

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: Visiting Professor in several American and European universities, in 1955 at Deccan College in Poona.

relations.subject: Henry M. Hoenigswald
relations.evidence: Married 1944 Gabriele (Gabi) Schoepflich (1912–2001, a classical scholar of German origin)
